requirements: R1: Address falsification findings by wiring JWT claims to the persistence layer, removing stubbed review/audit reports, and ensuring valid authenticated requests receive 200/201 responses.

slices.title: Patch Authentication Logic and Remove Falsification Stubs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want the JWT authentication logic fully wired to the persistence layer and stubbed reports resolved, so that the root causes of the self-falsification loop are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid authenticated API request, When the request is processed, Then it should be accepted with a 200/201 response.
Given a JWT token with valid claims, When it is parsed, Then the roles must be properly wired to the persistence layer.
Given the codebase, When the audit artifacts are reviewed, Then no stubbed or hallucinated review verdicts or coverage gaps should exist.
Given the changes, When the integration tests are run, Then the authentication flow must pass successfully.
